IGUI_Artemis_JournalKey_tooltip: The journal is only available once the operation has started (or in debug mode).
IGUI_Artemis_ActDesc0: No operation in progress. A note found on a dead soldier could change everything.
IGUI_Artemis_ActDesc1: A soldier's notebook mentions Operation Artemis. Find a radio and listen to %1 MHz, preferably at night. Storms scramble the signal.
IGUI_Artemis_ActDesc2: Follow the traces of Operation Artemis across Knox County, all the way to the file that explains everything.
IGUI_Artemis_ActDesc3: Leave the Exclusion Zone with the Artemis file: by the river, by air, or through a checkpoint.
IGUI_Artemis_ActDesc4: You left the zone. Operation Artemis is over.
IGUI_Artemis_J_Act1: I found a notebook on a dead soldier. It mentions an "Operation Artemis" and a frequency: %1.
IGUI_Artemis_J_Act2: %1 is still broadcasting. A voice talks about a bunker under March Ridge, and a badge.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_NoteRead: Who writes something like this on a soldier...?
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_Scream: That scream... it came from outside.
IGUI_Artemis_Radio_Numbers: Seven. One. Four. Nine... Two. Zero. Zero. Seven... Seven. One. Four. Nine.
IGUI_Artemis_Radio_Numbers2: Eight. Eight. Three... Zero. Six. One. One... Eight. Eight. Three... End of transmission.
IGUI_Artemis_Radio_Relay: This is Artemis relay. March Ridge sector is not responding. I repeat: March Ridge sector is not responding.
IGUI_Artemis_Radio_Plea: To anyone receiving this... the bunker, under March Ridge. The badge. Retrieve the badge. Do not stay there after nightfall.
IGUI_Artemis_J_Act3: I have the Artemis file. Now I have to get out of the zone.
IGUI_Artemis_J_Act4: I made it out of the zone.
IGUI_Artemis_ch1_bunker_Goal: March Ridge bunker: go in through the shed marked on the map and take the stairs down to level -4. The Artemis badge is in the desk at the back of the large room.
IGUI_Artemis_ch2_clinic_Goal: West Point clinic: the first patient's file is in the filing cabinet next to the exam room desk.
IGUI_Artemis_ch3_relay_Goal: Relay station (pylon) between Brandenburg and Riverside. Read the log in the office, get the relay powered again (power grid, or a running generator within 20 tiles), then turn on the radio on the control room table and listen to the tape to the end.
IGUI_Artemis_ch5_base_Goal: Base southwest of Rosewood. A guard fell by the east door: his access card opens the blast doors (keep it on you, not in a bag), and he had the base plan. The file is in the archives on level -17, reached by way of level -16: follow the red lights. According to V, the sensors go off every night from 23:15 to 1:15; outside those hours, the alarm rings while you're inside. The file is tagged: walking out of the archives with it sets off the alarm until you've left the base.
IGUI_Artemis_J_Ch1: The badge was in the bunker, with mission orders dated July 4th. Two days before anyone got sick. Collection point no. 1: the West Point clinic.
IGUI_Artemis_J_Ch2: Patient zero's file. They were waiting outside the clinic. The results went out through a radio relay, between Brandenburg and Riverside.
IGUI_Artemis_J_Ch3: The relay came back on and V's tape played. The numbers station was a call sign. He talks about a base southwest of Rosewood, and sensors going off every night from 23:15 to 1:15. Outside those hours, walking in means setting off the alarm.
IGUI_Artemis_J_Ch5: It's all in the file. Artemis was never a rescue operation. V wrote it: the file is tagged, the gate will ring. I'll have to get back up fast.
IGUI_Artemis_Base_Step1: cross the hall westward to the airlock; its stairs go down to level -13.
IGUI_Artemis_Base_Step1_Thought: The airlock is west of the hall.
IGUI_Artemis_Base_Step2: keep going down the airlock stairs to level -13.
IGUI_Artemis_Base_Step2_Thought: It goes down... a long way.
IGUI_Artemis_Base_Step3: level -13: cross the floor southward to the second stairs, which go down to -16.
IGUI_Artemis_Base_Step3_Thought: Level -13. The second stairs are to the south.
IGUI_Artemis_Base_Step5: level -17: follow the corridor north; the archives door is on the left, at the end. The file is in a filing cabinet.
IGUI_Artemis_Base_Step5_Thought: The corridor north. The archives at the end.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_arrive_ch1_bunker: A shed... and stairs going deep underground.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_done_ch1_bunker: An Artemis badge. They were here.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_read_ArtemisMission: West Point. The clinic... July 4th, before anyone else.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_alarm_ch1_bunker: A siren?! And it reeks of fumes... can't let this run long.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_arrive_ch2_clinic: The clinic. The filing cabinet by the desk, maybe.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_done_ch2_clinic: Patient zero. They were waiting at the door.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_read_ArtemisPatient: July sixth. They knew from day one. A radio relay, between Brandenburg and Riverside.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_arrive_ch3_relay: The pylon. If this relay still works... There's a desk.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_hint_ch3_read: The relay log must be in the desk drawer.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_hint_ch3_power: No power. I need a generator.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_read_ArtemisRelayLo: Get the power back, then turn on the radio in the control room.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_done_ch3_relay: 7-1-4-9... the radio numbers. A call sign.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_arrive_ch5_base: The base. Not a sound. And that guard, by the door...
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_read_ArtemisBasePla: The airlock stairs down to -13, then the south stairs to the bottom.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_read_ArtemisDossier: They need more data... And we are the data.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_act3: Got it. Now I have to get out of here.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_hint_ch3_radio: There's power. The radio on the control room table...
IGUI_Artemis_Tape_1: This is V. If you can hear this, the relay still has power. I don't have much time left.
IGUI_Artemis_Tape_2: The station's numbers aren't coordinates. 7-1-4-9 is a call sign. Remember it.
IGUI_Artemis_Tape_3: The Artemis file is at Rosewood-South, southwest of Rosewood. All the way down, level -17.
IGUI_Artemis_Tape_4: I set the sensors to shut off every night at 23:15. Two hours, until 1:15.
IGUI_Artemis_Tape_5: They won't evacuate us. They need more data, that's all that matters to them.
IGUI_Artemis_Tape_6: With that file, 7-1-4-9 gets you a way out. Without it, nobody will answer.
IGUI_Artemis_Tape_7: Don't linger down there. Take the file and get out... End of tape.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_read_ArtemisDossier: They'll come looking for me. Or to shut me up.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_surface_ch5_base: Fog. Good: they'll have a harder time seeing me.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_hint_ch3_log: The tape talks about Rosewood... The log in the office must say more.
IGUI_Artemis_Base_Step16: level -16: leave the stairs here. Follow the corridor north, then east, to the small stairs going back down to -17.
IGUI_Artemis_Base_StepWrong: level -17, wrong wing: the archives aren't here. Go back up to -16 by the stairs and follow the lights.
IGUI_Artemis_Base_StepWrong_Thought: Not this way. I need to go back up to -16.
IGUI_Artemis_J_Escape: Out of the base with the file. Behind me, the alarm fell silent.
IGUI_Artemis_Trial_ch5_base: Escape: the alarm is blaring. Climb back up and get out of the base with the file.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_alarm_ch5_gate: The gate! The whole base will come running... Up, now.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_alarm_ch5_sensors: An alarm! The sensors are live: it's not V's window.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_alarm_ch5_cut: Silence, all at once. 23:15: V shut the sensors off.
IGUI_Artemis_Call_Say: This is the bearer of the Artemis file, call sign %1. Requesting evacuation. Over.
IGUI_Artemis_Call_Reply: Call sign received. Knox Boundary Camp, south of Louisville. Pickup every day at dawn. Hold the zone until touchdown.
IGUI_Artemis_Call_Tooltip: Call the base on the Artemis channel and give the file's call sign.
IGUI_Artemis_Call_NotCarried: Hold the radio in your hand or wear it on your back.
IGUI_Artemis_Call_WrongFrequency: Tune the radio to the Artemis channel (%1 MHz).
IGUI_Artemis_J_Called: The base answered the call sign. A helicopter will come every day at dawn to Knox Boundary Camp, south of Louisville. I'll have to hold the zone until it lands.
IGUI_Artemis_J_Missed: The helicopter left without me. It will be back tomorrow at dawn.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_extraction_called: They answered. Knox Boundary Camp, at dawn.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_extraction_inbound: A rotor... They're coming. Hold the zone until it lands.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_extraction_landed: It's down! The green smoke... Run to the zone.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_extraction_missed: It's leaving... Tomorrow at dawn, then.
IGUI_Artemis_Radio_Exfil: To the bearer of the Artemis file: call on this frequency with a military radio.
IGUI_Artemis_Radio_Exfil2: Give the call sign. An evacuation is waiting for you.
IGUI_Artemis_Radio_Rendezvous: Knox Boundary Camp. Pickup every day at dawn.
IGUI_Artemis_Radio_Rendezvous2: Hold the zone until touchdown. Green smoke on the ground.
IGUI_Artemis_Radio_Farewell: This is V. The file is out. They can't say they didn't know anymore.
IGUI_Artemis_Radio_Farewell2: Thank you. Wherever you are now.
IGUI_Artemis_Exfil_Goal_Call: The file mentions an air evacuation from Knox Boundary Camp, south of Louisville (marked on the map). V left a US Army walkie-talkie in the archives, tuned to the Artemis channel (%1 MHz): hold it, turn it on, microphone on, then right-click the radio to call for evacuation and give the call sign. Any other military set works too.
IGUI_Artemis_Exfil_Goal_Rendezvous: Rendezvous at Knox Boundary Camp, every day at dawn: the rotor can be heard around 5 AM. Hold the zone until touchdown, then stay in the marked zone (green smoke), with the file on you, to board.
IGUI_Artemis_Chronicle_Days: Operation started on day %1, ended on day %2 (%3 days).
IGUI_Artemis_Chronicle_Route_B: Ending: air evacuation from Knox Boundary Camp, with the Artemis file.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_2: If you're hearing this, you made it out. The file made it out.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_3: For weeks, I watched Knox die behind screens. They called it a perimeter. Artemis was never a rescue operation: they needed more data. And the data was us.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_4: On July fourth, they already knew. In West Point, they were waiting outside the clinic door. At March Ridge, they took samples, counted, filed. And when the relay went silent, they shut the doors and let the zone do the rest.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_5: I couldn't get the file out myself. So I left lights on, a tape in a machine, numbers on a frequency nobody listened to.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_7: You crossed the county. You went seventeen floors down under Rosewood, you ran through the sirens, you held the zone until dawn. What you carry now are names. March Ridge, West Point, Riverside, Muldraugh. Everyone they counted and never saved.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_8: That file will pass from hand to hand. Reporters. Judges, maybe. They'll never be able to say they didn't know.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_9: Down there, the lights of Louisville are fading. The sun is rising over the Ohio.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_10: You survived. You got out. And because of you, someone will know.
IGUI_Artemis_RestartChoice: Operation Artemis has already been completed in this world. Restart the operation from the beginning with this character (a new notebook will have to be found)? No: keep the completed game.
IGUI_Artemis_J_SterilizationStart: The base relays an army notice: the zone is going to be "sterilized". I have to get out before the deadline, or only the river will be left.
IGUI_Artemis_J_Sterilized: They struck. The sky rumbles, ash is falling, the bombing is driving the hordes. The army is gone: no more helicopter, no more checkpoint. Only the river is left.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_sterilization_start: Sterilize the zone... They're going to erase everything. I have to get out, fast.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_sterilization_strik: That rumble... That's not a storm.
They did it. Only the river is left.
IGUI_Artemis_Radio_Sterilization: Army notice: zone sterilization operation imminent.
IGUI_Artemis_Radio_Sterilization2: Evacuate through the designated points before the deadline.
IGUI_Artemis_Radio_Sterilized: This is V. The base is empty. They left before the strike.
IGUI_Artemis_Radio_Sterilized2: Only the river is left. Head for the Ohio.
IGUI_Artemis_Sterilization_Countdown: Zone sterilization in %1 day(s): get out before the deadline.
IGUI_Artemis_Sterilization_Struck: Zone sterilized: the helicopter and the checkpoint won't come anymore. Only the river is left.
IGUI_Artemis_Chronicle_Route_A: Ending: out by boat down the Ohio, with the Artemis file.
IGUI_Artemis_Chronicle_Route_Aferry: Ending: crossing with V's ferryman from Brandenburg, with the Artemis file.
IGUI_Artemis_Chronicle_Route_C: Ending: quarantine at the Clark Memorial Bridge, negative test, with the Artemis file.
IGUI_Artemis_Chronicle_Route_Cnodossier: Ending: one-hour quarantine at the Clark Memorial Bridge, without the file. No one will know.
IGUI_Artemis_Chronicle_Exit_west: Out to the west, past the Esther Kinsella bridge.
IGUI_Artemis_Chronicle_Exit_northeast: Out to the northeast, past the Louisville boom.
IGUI_Artemis_Chronicle_Cure: With the cure for the virus in the bag.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_A_7: You crossed the county. You went seventeen floors down under Rosewood, you ran through the sirens, you killed their floodlights and slipped past the bridge in the dark. What you carry now are names. March Ridge, West Point, Riverside, Muldraugh. Everyone they counted and never saved.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_A_9: Behind you, the bridge fades into the mist. The river carries you away, and the sun is rising over the Ohio.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_Aferry_7: You crossed the county. You went seventeen floors down under Rosewood, you ran through the sirens, you killed their floodlights and waited for the ferryman until dawn. What you carry now are names. March Ridge, West Point, Riverside, Muldraugh. Everyone they counted and never saved.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_Aferry_9: The ferryman's engine coughs in the mist. Behind you, Knox is just a riverbank now. The sun is rising over the Ohio.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_C_7: You crossed the county. You went seventeen floors down under Rosewood, you ran through the sirens, and you waited behind their fence until they agreed to believe you. What you carry now are names. March Ridge, West Point, Riverside, Muldraugh. Everyone they counted and never saved.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_C_9: The bridge is behind you. At the end of it, Indiana. The sun is rising over the Ohio.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_Cnodossier_2: If you're hearing this, you made it out. Without the file.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_Cnodossier_7: You crossed the county. You saw what there was to see. You waited three days behind their fence, and they let you through.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_Cnodossier_8: The file stayed back there, somewhere in the zone. And the names with it. March Ridge, West Point, Riverside, Muldraugh.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_Cnodossier_9: The bridge is behind you. The sun is rising over the Ohio.
IGUI_Artemis_Epilogue_Cnodossier_10: You survived. That's already a lot. But no one will know.
IGUI_Artemis_Exfil_Goal_RiverBoat: V hid a boat at the Riverside pontoon (west exit, past the Esther Kinsella bridge) and another at the Louisville docks (northeast exit, past the army boom); the key is on the pontoon. The army posts light up the river: cut their generator on shore to slip past in the dark, or face the siren and a horde. Leave the map by boat, with the file on board.
IGUI_Artemis_Exfil_Goal_Ferry: Without a boat, V's ferryman crosses from the Brandenburg dock, but he won't pass the lit Esther Kinsella bridge: first cut the generator at the end of the bridge, then call the ferryman with the military radio (Artemis channel, %1 MHz) from the dock.
IGUI_Artemis_Exfil_Goal_FerryRendezvous: The ferryman comes every day at dawn to the Brandenburg dock. Hold the dock until he arrives, then stay at the end of the pontoon (green smoke), with the file on you, to board.
IGUI_Artemis_Exfil_Goal_Checkpoint: At the foot of the Clark Memorial Bridge, in Louisville: take the army blood test on the post's crate, in front of the pen. Negative, the gate opens: enter the pen for the quarantine (at most one hour, with or without the file).
IGUI_Artemis_Exfil_Goal_CheckpointVaccin: At the foot of the Clark Memorial Bridge, in Louisville: draw blood and analyze it at the post's spectrometer, in front of the pen (kit in the crate). Negative, the gate opens: enter the pen for the quarantine (at most one hour, with or without the file).
IGUI_Artemis_Exfil_Goal_CheckpointCleare: Entry test negative: the gate is open. Enter the pen without delay.
IGUI_Artemis_Exfil_Goal_Quarantine: Quarantine in progress: %1 h left. Stay in the pen: leaving it cancels everything.
IGUI_Artemis_Exfil_Goal_CheckpointPassed: Final test negative: the army opened a lane through the bridge barricade. Cross the bridge to the north.
IGUI_Artemis_Exfil_Goal_CheckpointRefuse: Test positive: the army refuses passage.
Test positive: the army refuses passage. A cure could change everything, then take the test again.
IGUI_Artemis_Checkpoint_TestTooltip: Army protocol: a blood sample analyzed at the post. Negative, the pen's gate opens for the quarantine.
IGUI_Artemis_Call_FerryReply: Ferryman here. Brandenburg, at dawn. Hold the dock, I won't wait long.
IGUI_Artemis_J_CheckpointPositive: The checkpoint test is positive. They won't let me through like this.
IGUI_Artemis_J_QuarantineStart: I'm in the checkpoint pen, at the foot of the Clark Memorial Bridge. At most one hour of quarantine, then one last test.
IGUI_Artemis_J_QuarantineStartNoDossier: I'm in the checkpoint pen, without the file. At most one hour of quarantine, then one last test.
IGUI_Artemis_J_QuarantineBroken: I left the pen: the quarantine has to start over, test included.
IGUI_Artemis_J_QuarantinePassed: The last test is negative. They opened a lane through the bridge barricade.
IGUI_Artemis_J_QuarantineRefused: The last test is positive. The gate opened again, but not the bridge.
IGUI_Artemis_J_FerryCalled: V's ferryman answered: he'll come every day at dawn to the Brandenburg dock.
IGUI_Artemis_J_FerryMissed: The ferryman left without me. He'll be back tomorrow at dawn.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_checkpoint_cleared: Negative. The gate's opening... Get into the pen.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_checkpoint_positive: Positive... They won't let me through.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_quarantine_start: The gate closes behind me. Hold on until the end.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_quarantine_broken: I'm out... It all has to start over.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_quarantine_passed: Negative. They're opening the barricade. The bridge, quick.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_river_swim: Not swimming, not with the file. I need a boat.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_river_nodossier: Without the file, all of this will have been for nothing.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_ferry_called: The ferryman will come. Brandenburg, at dawn.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_ferry_inbound: An engine on the water... Hold the dock.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_ferry_landed: He's docking! To the end of the pontoon, quick.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_ferry_missed: He's leaving... Tomorrow at dawn, then.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_ferry_refused: He won't pass the bridge floodlights. I have to cut their generator.
IGUI_Artemis_Speaker_Start: Quarantine. Stay in the pen. Final test at the end of the period.
IGUI_Artemis_Speaker_Routine: This is the checkpoint. Stay calm. Keep away from the fence.
IGUI_Artemis_Speaker_Stay: Any exit from the pen cancels the quarantine.
IGUI_Artemis_Speaker_Incident: Incident in the pen. Keep your distance. We cannot intervene.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_checkpoint_wait: Negative, but the pen is taken. I'll have to wait my turn.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_call_nodossier: No answer... Without the file, they won't come.
IGUI_Artemis_Radio_Ferry: This is V. The ferryman will come at dawn to the Brandenburg dock.
IGUI_Artemis_Radio_Ferry2: Hold the dock. He won't stay long.
IGUI_Artemis_Exfil_Smoke: Green smoke marks every place to go: V and his contacts mark the rendezvous points.
IGUI_Artemis_J_SiegeWarning: V called on the channel: "They know the file is out. They're sending everything tonight." I have to barricade before nightfall.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_siege_warning: They know... Tonight, they'll throw everything at me.
IGUI_Artemis_Radio_Siege: This is V. They know the file is out.
IGUI_Artemis_Radio_Siege2: They're sending everything tonight. Barricade before dark.
IGUI_Artemis_J_Supply_heli: V had a supply crate dropped at the edge of the Knox Boundary Camp landing field. Green smoke.
IGUI_Artemis_J_Supply_ferry: V had a supply crate dropped on the Brandenburg pontoon, for the wait for the ferryman. Green smoke.
IGUI_Artemis_J_Supply_checkpoint: V had a supply crate dropped in front of the checkpoint post, before the quarantine. Green smoke.
IGUI_Artemis_J_Supply_boatWest: V left a supply crate at the foot of the Riverside pontoon, near the boat. Green smoke.
IGUI_Artemis_J_Supply_boatEast: V left a supply crate on the Louisville dock, near the boat. Green smoke.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_supply_drop: A crate from V... Medicine, food, ammo. He thinks of everything.
IGUI_Artemis_CD_Mail:
From: management@wpclinic
To: staff
Subject: instructions

Following this morning's visit by federal agents, any feverish patient with bite wounds must be isolated in exam room 2. Do not contact the CDC. Samples will be collected by a courier. No copy of the files may leave the clinic.
IGUI_Artemis_CD_Shift: July 6, 3:40 AM. The patient in bed 4 no longer responds to sedatives. No pulse, but he moves. Two men in plain clothes have been waiting outside the door since midnight, as if they knew. I was bitten on the forearm holding him down. Locking myself in room 2 as a precaution.
IGUI_Artemis_CD_Lab: Samples no. 0 to 0-14: unidentified agent, abnormally fast replication. Shipment requested to "satellite lab" (address masked) on Artemis orders. Duplicate kept here, against instructions.
IGUI_Artemis_Laptop_1: They talk about an "observation window". The perimeter will be held, whatever happens inside. I'm supposed to count. Just count.
IGUI_Artemis_Laptop_2: March Ridge isn't answering anymore. We were ordered not to send a team. I copied what I could into the paper file. The network, they read; paper, they forgot.
IGUI_Artemis_Laptop_3: I'm leaving the walkie tuned in the cabinet. If someone makes it down here, they followed the numbers. Take the file. Call them. Don't stay.
IGUI_Artemis_ch4_lab_Goal: Underground lab beneath the Tikitown office (relay waybill). Go in by the south door, take the stairwell down to level -4 and search the desks: V left notes there. The samples are in the morgue, on -5.
IGUI_Artemis_J_Ch3_Lab: The relay came back on and V's tape played. The numbers station was a call sign. In the desk, a waybill: samples from West Point shipped to a satellite lab beneath Tikitown. V went there before the base.
IGUI_Artemis_J_Ch4: V's notes, deep in the Tikitown lab: they studied the West Point samples there, on "subjects". Everything else is in the base southwest of Rosewood, sensors off every night from 23:15 to 1:15.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_read_ArtemisWaybill: Samples shipped beneath Tikitown... V must have gone there.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_arrive_ch4_lab: An ordinary office. But the stairs go down much too far.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_read_ArtemisLabNote: They weren't trying to cure anything. They were measuring.
IGUI_Artemis_Thought_done_ch4_lab: The base, now. Everything is there.
